CustomField.description: Total value last month (for NB's reports - do not delete)
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( AND( YEAR(CloseDate) = YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(CloseDate) = MONTH(TODAY()) - 1, text(Opportunity_Type_Forecast__c )= "New Business" ), AND( YEAR(CloseDate) = YEAR(TODAY()) - 1, MONTH(CloseDate) = 12, text( Opportunity_Type_Forecast__c )= "New Business" ) ), Amount, 0 )
CustomField.label: Total Value Last Month
